361#pragma intrinsic(_BitScanForward)

372#define TOMMY_ILOG2(value) ((value) == 256 ? 8 : (value) == 128 ? 7 : (value) == 64 ? 6 : (value) == 32 ? 5 : (value) == 16 ? 4 : (value) == 8 ? 3 : (value) == 4 ? 2 : (value) == 2 ? 1 : 0)
373
392tommy_inline tommy_uint_t tommy_ilog2_u32(tommy_uint32_t value)
393{
394#if defined(_MSC_VER)
395 unsigned long count;
396 _BitScanReverse(&count, value);
397 return count;
398#elif defined(__GNUC__)
399 /*
400 * GCC implements __builtin_clz(x) as "__builtin_clz(x) = bsr(x) ^ 31"
401 *
402 * Where "x ^ 31 = 31 - x", but gcc does not optimize "31 - __builtin_clz(x)" to bsr(x),
403 * but generates 31 - (bsr(x) xor 31).
404 *
405 * So we write "__builtin_clz(x) ^ 31" instead of "31 - __builtin_clz(x)",
406 * to allow the double xor to be optimized out.
407 */
408 return __builtin_clz(value) ^ 31;
409#else
410 /* find the log base 2 of an N-bit integer in O(lg(N)) operations with multiply and lookup */
411 /* from http://graphics.stanford.edu/~seander/bithacks.html */
412 static const unsigned char TOMMY_DE_BRUIJN_INDEX_ILOG2[32] = {
413 0, 9, 1, 10, 13, 21, 2, 29, 11, 14, 16, 18, 22, 25, 3, 30,
414 8, 12, 20, 28, 15, 17, 24, 7, 19, 27, 23, 6, 26, 5, 4, 31
415 };
416
417 value |= value >> 1;
418 value |= value >> 2;
419 value |= value >> 4;
420 value |= value >> 8;
421 value |= value >> 16;
422
423 return TOMMY_DE_BRUIJN_INDEX_ILOG2[(tommy_uint32_t)(value * 0x07C4ACDDU) >> 27];
424#endif
425}

435tommy_inline tommy_uint_t tommy_ilog2_u64(tommy_uint64_t value)
436{
437#if defined(_MSC_VER) && defined(_WIN64)
438 unsigned long count;
439 _BitScanReverse64(&count, value);
440 return count;
441#elif defined(__GNUC__)
442 return __builtin_clzll(value) ^ 63;
443#else
444 tommy_uint32_t l = value & 0xFFFFFFFFU;
445 tommy_uint32_t h = value >> 32;
446 if (h)
447 return tommy_ilog2_u32(h) + 32;
448 else
449 return tommy_ilog2_u32(l);
450#endif
451}

461tommy_inline tommy_uint_t tommy_ctz_u32(tommy_uint32_t value)
462{
463#if defined(_MSC_VER)
464 unsigned long count;
465 _BitScanForward(&count, value);
466 return count;
467#elif defined(__GNUC__)
468 return __builtin_ctz(value);
469#else
470 /* count the consecutive zero bits (trailing) on the right with multiply and lookup */
471 /* from http://graphics.stanford.edu/~seander/bithacks.html */
472 static const unsigned char TOMMY_DE_BRUIJN_INDEX_CTZ[32] = {
473 0, 1, 28, 2, 29, 14, 24, 3, 30, 22, 20, 15, 25, 17, 4, 8,
474 31, 27, 13, 23, 21, 19, 16, 7, 26, 12, 18, 6, 11, 5, 10, 9
475 };
476
477 return TOMMY_DE_BRUIJN_INDEX_CTZ[(tommy_uint32_t)(((value & -value) * 0x077CB531U)) >> 27];
478#endif
479}

489tommy_inline tommy_uint_t tommy_ctz_u64(tommy_uint64_t value)
490{
491#if defined(_MSC_VER) && defined(_WIN64)
492 unsigned long count;
493 _BitScanForward64(&count, value);
494 return count;
495#elif defined(__GNUC__)
496 return __builtin_ctzll(value);
497#else
498 tommy_uint32_t l = value & 0xFFFFFFFFU;
499 tommy_uint32_t h = value >> 32;
500 if (l)
501 return tommy_ctz_u32(l);
502 else
503 return tommy_ctz_u32(h) + 32;
504#endif
505}

513tommy_inline tommy_uint32_t tommy_roundup_pow2_u32(tommy_uint32_t value)
514{
515 /* round up to the next highest power of 2 */
516 /* from http://graphics.stanford.edu/~seander/bithacks.html */
517
518 --value;
519 value |= value >> 1;
520 value |= value >> 2;
521 value |= value >> 4;
522 value |= value >> 8;
523 value |= value >> 16;
524 ++value;
525
526 return value;
527}
528
535tommy_inline tommy_uint64_t tommy_roundup_pow2_u64(tommy_uint64_t value)
536{
537 --value;
538 value |= value >> 1;
539 value |= value >> 2;
540 value |= value >> 4;
541 value |= value >> 8;
542 value |= value >> 16;
543 value |= value >> 32;
544 ++value;
545
546 return value;
547}

554tommy_inline int tommy_haszero_u32(tommy_uint32_t value)
555{
556 return ((value - 0x01010101) & ~value & 0x80808080) != 0;
557}
558
564tommy_inline int tommy_haszero_u64(tommy_uint64_t value)
565{
566 return ((value - 0x0101010101010101ULL) & ~value & 0x8080808080808080ULL) != 0;
567}
